name: 5050 Potazos Mint Magic
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), REFINED PALMOLEIN, PALM & SUNFLOWER OIL, SUGAR, DEHYDRATED POTATO FLAKES (11.3%), MALTODEXTRIN, IODISED SALT, RAISING AGENTS [503(ii) & 500 (ii)], LIQUID GLUCOSE, INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, SPICES & CONDIMENTS, NATURAL & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, MILK SOLIDS, VITAL WHEAT GLUTEN, GARLIC POWDER, EMULSIFIERS [322(i) & 471], FLAVOUR ENHANCERS (627 & 631), ANTICAKING AGENT (551), DOUGH CONDITIONER (223), RICE FLOUR, IMPROVER [1101], ONION POWDER, STABILIZER (1450), MINT OIL (0.001%), ACIDITY REGULATOR (330) AND COLOUR (110). (Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System) CONTAINS WHEAT GLUTEN, MILK, SOYA AND SULPHITE.
